title: Heat Index Safety Alert
dataSources: Weather-station observations (`ecowitt:obs`, `weatherflow:obs`), air-quality readings (`purpleair:aqi`, `airgradient:sensor`), soil-moisture and greenhouse sensors (`plant:sensor`), aquarium controllers (`aquarium:sensor`).
app: Personal weather stations (Ecowitt/Ambient/Davis/WeatherFlow), air-quality sensors (PurpleAir/AirGradient), and aquarium/greenhouse/soil sensors via HEC and MQTT.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=ecowitt:obs
| stats latest(temp_c) as temp_c, latest(humidity_pct) as humidity by station
| eval heat_index_c=round(temp_c+(humidity/100*6)-4,1)
| where heat_index_c>32
| sort - heat_index_c
description: Combines temperature and humidity into a simple heat-index proxy so you know when outdoor conditions have shifted from warm to genuinely risky.
value: Raw temperature misses how oppressive humid heat feels; a safety-focused composite is better for outdoor work, pets, and exercise decisions.
implementation: Forward weather-station temperature and humidity; alert when the calculated heat index enters your danger zone.
visualization: Current-condition panel of temperature, humidity, and heat-index proxy.
grandmaExplanation: It logs when the combination of heat and humidity outside is getting dangerous, not just uncomfortable.
